ig_caption:
57 failed requests during a normal Kubernetes update 😬 (zero-downtime fix inside)

Our AI chatbot on Kubernetes: 3 replicas, looks resilient. But:
⚠️ no readinessProbe
⚠️ the app needs 8 s to load the model, and Kubernetes sends traffic the moment the container starts

The fix:
✅ readinessProbe: traffic only goes to pods that really answer
✅ rollingUpdate maxUnavailable: 0: old pods stay until the new ones are ready

Same update → 0 failed requests.

Kubernetes is only as smart as what you tell it.

Save this for your next deploy 🔖 Follow to see this chatbot reach production 🚀

#kubernetes #devops #k8s #genai #ai
yt_title: Kubernetes rolling update: 57 failed requests and the fix #kubernetes
yt_description:
Real test on a local kind cluster: a request every 0.1 s while a new version rolls out.
- 3 replicas, no readiness probe, app takes 8 s to start: 186 OK, 57 failed
- readinessProbe + rollingUpdate maxUnavailable: 0 → 249 OK, 0 failed

Zero-downtime deployments need Kubernetes to know when your app is actually ready.

Part of the "AI App to Production" journey: one AI chatbot from laptop to production. Follow along.

#kubernetes #devops #k8s #zerodowntime #genai
